question: According to Table 2, what lactic acid and acetic acid concentrations did the well-fermented group (LPGood) have?
rendered: According to Table 2, the LPGood group had a lactic acid concentration of 11.27 ± 0.16 g/kg DM and an acetic acid concentration of 9.18 ± 0.46 g/kg DM.
